components.name: TimelineActivity
components.description:
Figma `Timeline/Activity` (16131:1311): an activity feed — day kickers (Body/Small/Bold, Neutral/Light: "Today",
"Yesterday", then the date) over `Timeline/Item` rows, kicker → items Gap/XSmall, day → day Gap/Large; each day's last
item has no connector. Newest first. A list per day, named by its kicker.

props.name: entries
props.description: The entries (any order): shown newest first, grouped by day.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today ("Today", "Yesterday" kickers). Default: the device clock.

props.name: size
props.description: Item size: `md` (default) or `sm` (a compact log).

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (640) or `mobile` (358); the items are the same. Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the items (`{ "Item[approve]/Marker": { tone: "positive" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: TimelineItem
components.description:
Figma `Timeline/Item` (16131:1090): one entry of an activity history — a 24px rail (the marker, then a 2px
Border/Neutral/Subtle connector, Gap/2XSmall), then the body (Padding-top 3XSmall, Padding-bottom Large / Small,
Gap/2XSmall): the actor in Body/Small/Bold and what they did in Body/Small/Regular (Strongest) beside the time
(Caption/Regular Light, Gap/XSmall), an optional detail (Body/Small/Regular Base) and attachment. Gap/Small (Small:
XSmall) between rail and body.

props.name: actor
props.description: The actor, in Body/Small/Bold ("Maya Chen").

props.name: title
props.description: What happened, after the actor (" approved your leave request").

props.name: time
props.description: Figma Time ("10:42").

props.name: description
props.description: Figma Description + Detail: one line of detail ("Annual leave · Oct 12 – Oct 16").

props.name: attachment
props.description:
Figma Attachment + Attachment-Slot: a comment, a file, a change. A string draws the comment box (Surface/Alt,
Padding/Small, Corner-Radius/Base); pass a node for your own.

props.name: connector
props.description: Figma Connector: the rail down to the next item (off on a group's last item). Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: `md` (24px marker, Large after each item, default) or `sm` (Small after; a Dot marker suits it).

props.name: marker
props.description: The marker (Type, Tone, icon, avatar). Default: Icon Accent (Medium), Dot Neutral (Small).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the marker (`{ "Marker": { tone: "positive" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: TimelineMilestones

props.name: milestones
props.description: The milestones, in date order.

props.name: today
props.description:
The day treated as today: milestones before it are Done, the first on or after it is Current, the rest Upcoming.
Default: the device clock.

props.name: currentId
props.description: The Current milestone by id, when it is not the date's (a late phase).

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (a row; items share the width) or `mobile` (a column). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<ol>`.

components.name: TimelineGantt
components.description:
Figma `Timeline/Gantt` (16136:859): a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px Pale, Corner-Radius/Base,
clipped) — a 40px header ("Tasks" and the week starts, Caption/Medium Neutral/Base) over a task column of
`.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Label` rows (240, 128 on a phone) beside a track of 44px rows with week columns, Pale rules
outside the layout. `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Bar` bars sit by date — x = days from the first column × day width + 2,
width = days × day width − 4, centred in the row — and keep their real dates past the edge (the track scrolls; never
squeezed). A group's Summary spans its tasks; the vertical `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` marks today. On a phone,
milestone titles live in the task column only.

Semantics: a `role="table"` — the week headers, then per row a row header (the label; a group's is a disclosure that
hides its tasks) and one cell with its bar (a button with `onTaskClick`).

props.name: groups
props.description: The plan: groups of tasks. A group's summary bar spans its tasks.

props.name: start
props.description: First day of the scale (rounded to its Monday). Default: the Monday of the earliest task.

props.name: weeks
props.description: How many weeks the scale shows (default 9).

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today: the vertical now line. Default: the device clock.

props.name: onTaskClick
props.description: Pressing a task or milestone bar: open it, anchored to `target`. Without it the bars are static.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Groups collapsed at first (by id).

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (240px task column, the whole scale) or `mobile` (128px column, three weeks visible; the
track scrolls and opens at today, else the plan's start). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the plan (default the locale's "Tasks").

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the labels and bars (`{ "Bar[ui]": { color: "teal" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: TimelineMarker
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Marker` (16130:55): the 24px marker on a timeline rail. Dot: 10px —
`Color/Background/<Tone>/Solid/Default`, Neutral a Surface dot with a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid ring. Icon: Dock-Icon
XSmall Subtle (Neutral, Accent, Green, Orange, Red). Avatar: Avatar/Single XSmall Subtle. Decorative: the item says what
happened.

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Type: `dot` (10px; Neutral is hollow), `icon` (Dock-Icon XSmall, Subtle) or `avatar` (Avatar XSmall, one
initial). Avatar when a person did it, Icon when the system did, Dot in compact logs.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figma Tone (status, not decoration). Default neutral.

props.name: icon
props.description: Type=Icon: the icon (default the tone's: edit, message, check, clock, flag).

props.name: avatarName
props.description: Type=Avatar: the person's name (its initial) and photo.

props.name: avatarTheme
props.description: Type=Avatar without a photo: the initial's theme (default teal).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the Dock-Icon / Avatar it draws (`{ "Icon": { theme: "blue" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<span>`.

components.name: TimelineMilestone
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Milestone` (16130:147): one dated milestone. Horizontal: an axis (a 16px marker box, then a
2px connector, Gap/2XSmall) over the content (Padding-right Small, Gap/3XSmall), Gap/XSmall. Vertical: a 16px rail
(Padding-top 3XSmall) beside the content (Padding-bottom Large), Gap/Small. Date Caption/Medium (Current Accent/Base,
else Neutral/Light), Title Body/Small/Medium (Current Bold) Strongest, Description Caption/Regular Light. Markers as the
Itinerary's: Done Accent dot, Current a 16px Accent ring, Upcoming a hollow Neutral/Solid ring; connectors Accent after
Done, Border/Neutral/Subtle otherwise.

props.name: date
props.description: Figma Date ("Sep 25").

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title ("Design sign-off").

props.name: description
props.description: Figma Description: one line of detail (shown on the Current milestone).

props.name: status
props.description:
Figma Status: `done` (Accent dot and connector), `current` (Accent ring, Accent date, bold title) or `upcoming`
(a hollow neutral dot).

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Figma Orientation: `horizontal` (marker and connector above the text; desktop) or `vertical` (the rail on the left;
phones). Default horizontal.

props.name: connector
props.description: Figma Connector (off on the last milestone). Default true.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: TimelineGanttBar
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Bar` (16130:77), 28px high. Task: Padding 2XSmall · XSmall, Corner-Radius/XSmall,
`Color/Background/Support/<Hue>/Subtle` with a 2px `Color/Border/Support/<Hue>/Solid` leading rule, the title in
Caption/Bold Strongest (one line). Summary: an 8px Corner-Radius/2XSmall `Color/Background/Neutral/Solid/Default` bar.
Milestone: an 11px Accent/Solid square turned 45° in a 16px box, the title (Caption/Bold Strongest) Gap/XSmall after it.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title (inside a task, beside a milestone; a summary shows none).

props.name: kind
props.description:
Figma Kind: `task` (Subtle hue with a Solid leading rule, the title inside), `summary` (a group's span: an 8px
Neutral bar) or `milestone` (an Accent diamond with the title beside it).

props.name: color
props.description: Figma Color for tasks: the workstream (default brand).

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Hide a milestone's title (the phone Gantt shows it in the task column only).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Pressing the bar (open the task). Without it the bar is static.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (a `<button>` when pressable, else a `<div>`).

components.name: TimelineGanttLabel
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Label` (16130:90): a 44px row of the Gantt's task column with a Pale rule below —
Group: Padding 0 · Small, Gap/XSmall, icon-chevron-down-line, Body/Small/Bold; Task: 32 from the left, Body/Small/Regular
and the assignee's Avatar XSmall.

props.name: name
props.description: Figma Name. One line, truncated.

props.name: level
props.description:
Figma Level: `group` (a chevron and Body/Small/Bold; collapses its tasks) or `task` (indented 32, Body/Small/Regular,
the assignee).

props.name: assignee
props.description: Figma Assignee (task): the person, as an Avatar XSmall.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Group: whether its tasks show (the chevron points down). With `onToggle` the label is a disclosure button.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Group: show or hide its tasks.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

types.TimelineTaskData: interface TimelineTaskData { id: string; name: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end?: CalendarDateInput; kind?: "task" | "milestone"; color?: CalendarColor; assignee?: { src?: string; alt?: string }; }
